audience: businesses that manage invoices, clients and products in Fakturowo

useCases.title: Review invoices and their line items
useCases.text: The AI lists documents by type or seller/buyer tax number, then opens a selected invoice to review its line items, VAT, totals and payment status.

useCases.title: Look up saved clients and products
useCases.text: The AI finds client contact details and checks product catalogue entries, including units, VAT rates and net prices, before you prepare a document.

useCases.title: Issue a document with the details you provide
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice, proforma or receipt using your buyer and line items. It is saved immediately, so review the details first and issue documents one at a time.

useCases.title: Record an invoice payment status
useCases.text: The AI reads an invoice and, when requested, marks it unpaid, paid or partially paid and optionally records the amount already paid.
